gt_world_add.description: Add a world and assign it a channel

options.kanal: Channel where this world's reports will be posted

gt_member_add.description: Assign players to a world's roster

options.lista: Player nicknames, separated by commas or new lines

gt_member_delete.description: Remove a player from a world

report.description: Upload a battle screenshot; OCR reads absences

options.data: Report date: DD.MM or DD.MM.YYYY (defaults to today if omitted)

options.okres: Time window to include (default: all time, ignored if 'od' or 'do' is set)
options.od: Custom range start: DD.MM or DD.MM.YYYY (e.g. 10.07)
options.do: Custom range end: DD.MM or DD.MM.YYYY (e.g. 17.07)

options.data: Report date: DD.MM or DD.MM.YYYY (defaults to today)

gt_wipe.description: Wipe all absence data for this server

gt_reports_wipe.description: Delete reports by exact date or by age

options.data: Exact battle date to delete (DD.MM[.YYYY]). Omit to delete reports older than 3 days.

gt_ranking_set.description: Turn the weekly auto-ranking post on/off

options.enabled: Turn the automatic weekly ranking on or off for this world
options.weekday: Day of the week to post it (only used if enabled)

options.swiat: Show only this world's schedule (omit to list every world)

gt_block_image.description: Manually blocklist a known scam image

options.reason: Why this image is being blocked (optional)

gt_setup_settings.description: Edit a single setting without a full reset

gt_events_setup.description: Set the webhook channel for event posts

options.channel: The channel that receives official game news/event webhooks

options.state: True to enable, False to disable

options.channel: Channel to post the recruitment panel in
options.officer_role: Role that can review and decide on applications
options.member_role: Optional: role automatically given to accepted applicants
options.member_role_2: Optional: additional rank given to accepted applicants
options.member_role_3: Optional: additional rank given to accepted applicants
options.member_role_4: Optional: additional rank given to accepted applicants

gt_attack_setup.description: Set alert channel + ping role per world

options.channel: Channel where attack alerts for this world will be posted
options.ping_role: Role to ping when an attack alert is triggered for this world
options.mute_defense: Suppress automated defense-alert pings for this world (leave unset to keep current)

gt_sf_login.description: Securely connect a Shakes & Fidget account for guild monitoring.

options.user: Admin only: register on behalf of another member (defaults to yourself)

gt_sf_logout.description: Delete your stored Shakes & Fidget credentials from the bot.

options.world: Only remove this world (omit to remove all of yours)

gt_sf_toggle_checks.description: Turn the hourly guild attack/defense check on or off for your account.

options.state: True to enable hourly checks, False to disable
options.world: Apply to this world only (omit for all of your accounts)

gt_sf_status.description: Show your connected Shakes & Fidget accounts and their check status.
